boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-cost campus and Indianola activities, with student-only access noted where applicable.

cards.title: Join a Simpson Fitness class
cards.subtitle: Steven Johnson Fitness Center · Simpson College
cards.notes: Check the current class schedule, then bring a friend for yoga, Pilates, kickboxing, or another listed session at the fitness center.
cards.short_summary: Instructor-led campus exercise classes with no charge for Simpson students.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson states that its fitness classes are free and open to all Simpson students, faculty, and staff.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to Simpson students, faculty, and staff; consult the current schedule before going.

cards.title: Share LIFT community night
cards.subtitle: Smith Memorial Chapel · Simpson College
cards.notes: Go to Smith Chapel for the weekly community night: start with the home-cooked meal, then stay for dialogue-based worship and communion.
cards.short_summary: A weekly chapel gathering centered on a free meal and conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson describes LIFT as a weekly community night that starts with a free, home-cooked meal and ends with dialogue-based worship.
cards.access_notes: Held at Holy Grounds in Smith Chapel; confirm the weekly gathering details with Campus Ministry.

cards.entity_name: Simpson College Gallery of Art and Design
cards.title: See the campus art gallery
cards.subtitle: Simpson College Gallery of Art and Design
cards.notes: Drop in during weekday gallery hours to view the current exhibition, or arrange a weekend appointment using the gallery contact listed by Simpson.
cards.short_summary: A rotating campus gallery with public exhibitions and artist presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson states that all Gallery of Art and Design exhibitions and presentations are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Simpson College Gallery of Art and Design
cards.access_notes: Public access; listed weekday hours are 9 a.m.–4:30 p.m., with weekend viewing available by appointment.

cards.title: Attend the Research and Creativity Symposium
cards.subtitle: Simpson College campus
cards.notes: Make time for student papers, performances, posters, and panels; use the symposium page to confirm the next program and locations.
cards.short_summary: An annual showcase of Simpson student research and creative work.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson says its Annual Research and Creativity Symposium is free for both participants and attendees.
cards.source_title: Annual Research and Creativity Symposium - Simpson College
cards.access_notes: Open to attendees; check Simpson’s symposium information for the next annual date and program.

cards.title: Catch an Iowa History Speaker Series talk
cards.subtitle: Indianola · Iowa History Center at Simpson College
cards.notes: Watch the Iowa History Center announcements and bring a classmate to a public talk on Iowa history or culture when the next program is posted.
cards.short_summary: Public talks on Iowa history and culture presented through Simpson’s Iowa History Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson states that Iowa History Speaker Series events are free, open to the general public, and held in Indianola.
cards.access_notes: Open to the general public; follow Iowa History Center announcements for upcoming speakers and venues.

cards.title: Join George Washington Carver Day
cards.subtitle: Simpson College and Indianola
cards.notes: Plan for the annual program honoring Simpson alumnus George Washington Carver; review the event schedule for talks, panels, and locations.
cards.short_summary: A college-and-community celebration of George Washington Carver’s Simpson and Indianola connection.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson states that all George Washington Carver Day Celebration events are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: George Washington Carver Day Celebration - Simpson College
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; dates, venues, and individual program details vary by annual schedule.

cards.title: Read and browse at Indianola Public Library
cards.subtitle: 207 N. B St. · Indianola
cards.notes: Meet at the library to browse books and materials, read together, or settle into a low-key study break without buying anything.
cards.short_summary: A public library space with free use of its books and materials on site.
cards.evidence_claim: The Indianola Public Library says it provides free and equitable access to information and resources.
cards.source_title: The Indianola Public Library - City of Indianola
cards.access_notes: Public library at 207 N. B St.; check posted hours before visiting. Printing is a separate paid service.

cards.title: Digitize photos or papers together
cards.subtitle: Indianola Public Library · 207 N. B St.
cards.notes: Bring a document or photo project and use the library scanner to send files to email, a USB drive, or a public-use laptop.
cards.short_summary: A no-charge way to scan documents and images for a shared project.
cards.evidence_claim: Indianola Public Library states that scanning is free to the public and can be sent to email, USB, or a public-use laptop.
cards.source_title: Printing, Scanning, & Faxing - Indianola Public Library
cards.access_notes: Available to the public at the library; scanning supports items up to 11 by 17 inches.

cards.title: Book free test proctoring
cards.subtitle: Indianola Public Library · 207 N. B St.
cards.notes: If an online course or certification allows it, request a library proctor at least three business days ahead and confirm your exam’s requirements.
cards.short_summary: No-charge proctoring for students who arrange an eligible exam in advance.
cards.evidence_claim: Indianola Public Library states that its test-proctoring service has no charge, though associated postage or printing may cost extra.
cards.source_title: Request a Test Proctor - Indianola Public Library
cards.access_notes: Request at least three business days in advance; any required postage or printing is the student’s responsibility.

cards.title: Host a library-streaming watch night
cards.subtitle: Indianola Public Library digital collection
cards.notes: Use an eligible Indianola or rural Warren County library card to choose a documentary, film, or show on Kanopy for a relaxed watch session.
cards.short_summary: Free library-card streaming through Kanopy and Kanopy Kids.
cards.evidence_claim: Indianola Public Library states that movies, TV shows, documentaries, and kids videos stream free with Kanopy and Kanopy Kids.
cards.access_notes: Kanopy access is limited to cardholders living in Indianola or rural Warren County; adult Kanopy has monthly credits, while Kanopy Kids needs none.
